This task only adds the error type; later tasks use it.

Work from: /Users/smaschek/dev/paigasus/paigasus-helikon-sma-864 (a git worktree; use absolute paths under it).

If something is unclear, ask before you start. Do not dispatch subagents; self-review means reading your own diff.
